Publications

Academic records appear first, followed by thesis, policy, media, and resource work.

Academic Publication

Preventing the Root Causes of Youth Homelessness Through Cultural and Critical Pedagogies

Peer-reviewed article framing schools as sites of harm and potential, emphasizing upstream prevention, institutional misrecognition, lived experience as knowledge, and teacher education.

APA 7
Battista, A. (2026). Preventing the root causes of youth homelessness through cultural and critical pedagogies: An autoethnographic qualitative study of Quebec schools and institutions informed by lived and professional experience. International Journal on Homelessness, 6(2), 1-32. https://doi.org/10.5206/ijoh.2026.2.22959
Open source

Graduate Thesis

Youth homelessness prevention through education: reimagining Quebec’s education system as a tool for youth homelessness prevention

Graduate thesis exploring youth homelessness prevention through Quebec education policy, autoethnographic research, case studies, and critical pedagogy.

APA 7
Battista, A. (2025). Youth homelessness prevention through education: Reimagining Quebec’s education system as a tool for youth homelessness prevention [Graduate thesis, McGill University]. eScholarship@McGill.
Open source

Policy Work

Prevention Without School-Based Infrastructure: A Critical Autoethnographic Policy Analysis of Quebec's Interministerial Plan to End Homelessness and Educational Policy

Forthcoming policy work analyzing Quebec’s interministerial plan to end homelessness and the role of school-based prevention.

APA 7
Battista, A. (forthcoming). Prevention without school-based infrastructure: A critical autoethnographic policy analysis of Quebec's interministerial plan to end homelessness and educational policy.
Open source
